_comment: G0 part 2 protocol = recover's G0 part 1 settings (T03_T05.md 'G0 part 1', paper_eval_sweep.sh) on the MJX eval. See T04.md section 8.

_evidence.episode_length_in_seconds: G0 part 1 uses EP_SECONDS=5 (T03_T05.md); 5 s = 250 steps = the 250-step success threshold, so success = not terminated
_evidence.noise_std: committed test() semantics, N(0,1) on the processed action (G0 part 1)
_evidence.push_scale / push_scale_joints: PERT_SCALE=2 on all four perturbation bounds (paper_eval_sweep.sh)
_evidence.push_impl: env_traced = the env's own pushes with probability/scale traced into one compile; equal to push_impl=env (test_env_traced_pushes_equal_env_pushes)
_evidence.background_push_prob: -1 = env config 0.002 during the noise suites (CPU env default, also in G0 part 1)
_evidence.initial_command_zero_prob: 10 sequential 5 s episodes per process in G0 part 1: P(episode starts at command 0) ~ sum_k exp(-0.5 k)/10 = 0.25
_evidence.paper_shield: cpu_test for paper-code checkpoints (paper, T05, T06a) = the test() shield of G0 part 1; T06b uses its own v2 shield with the trained parameters
_evidence.gamma_c: as trained: run_eval_sweep.py passes the checkpoint's shield parameters (shield_args_from_checkpoint)
_evidence.eval_seeds: one fixed seed for all groups (paired); 1024 envs per point (G0 part 1: 10 episodes x 1 eval seed)
